# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.2.4 - 2026-11-04

- First version in this marketplace: the DuckDB Skills skills, copied from https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-skills at commit `7feda8e`.
- Skill files are unchanged from the vendor's.
- The vendor's plugin-level files (`.claude-plugin/`, `README.md`) are not included. BoldCreate Connect delivers only the skills folder.
